Converts dotted-decimal IPv4 strings to a packed IPv4 address.

# Purpose
Parses an IPv4 address from a C string and stores the result in a `uint` value. The helper [`__fd_cstr_to_uchar`](<#__fd_cstr_to_uchar>) converts one decimal token to an unsigned byte and rejects empty input, extra characters, and values above `UCHAR_MAX`. The function [`fd_cstr_to_ip4_addr`](<#fd_cstr_to_ip4_addr>) copies the input into a fixed local buffer, splits it into four `.`-separated tokens with `fd_cstr_tokenize`, converts each token, and builds the address with `FD_IP4_ADDR`. It returns `1` on success and `0` on parse failure.
